mostWorthwhile.text: Fermenting the food remainder was most worthwhile: it showed how bacteria use fibre left after digestion and produce small molecules and gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the fermenting contents to the body felt like an intermediate placement; it situated the contents but did not yet show the exchange I was waiting to see.

surprise.text: The final result showed that colon cells can use some microbial products and that some enter the blood.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although adding mucus after placing the contents was the only available combination.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it similarly connects familiar body functions to less obvious interactions. The clear final exchange was engaging, though the intermediate placement felt routine.
